title: Pointwise topology on natural automorphisms of an arbitrary set-valued functor
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category [def-nagata-category] and $F:\mathcal C\to\mathbf{Set}_w$ any functor, with no finiteness assumption on its fibres. For a set $A$, give $A$ the discrete topology and give $\operatorname{Aut}(A)$ the topology induced by $\sigma\mapsto(a\mapsto\sigma(a))$ into $A^A$ with its product topology. Define the evaluation homomorphism $\operatorname{ev}_F:\operatorname{Aut}(F)\to\prod_{X\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)}\operatorname{Aut}(F(X))$ by $\alpha\mapsto(\alpha_X)_X$. Give $\operatorname{Aut}(F)$ the topology induced by this homomorphism from the product of those pointwise topologies. Equivalently, a basic neighbourhood of $\alpha$ prescribes $\beta_X(x)=\alpha_X(x)$ at finitely many pairs $(X,x)$ with $x\in F(X)$. The object, morphism and fibre universes are independent.
